{{Recipe}}

'''Zimbabwean chicken and vegetable soup''' is a delicious soup that combines a variety of vegetables with peanut [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]] and a few red pepper flakes.

== Ingredients ==

* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]

* 1 [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]]
* 4 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] vegetable [[Cookbook:Broth and Stock|stock]], divided
* ½ cup [[Cookbook:Peanut Butter|peanut butter]]
* 2 cups canned diced [[Cookbook:Tomatoes with Cheese Stuffing|tomatoes]], with juices
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Chile Flakes|crushed red pepper flakes]], or more to taste
* 1 cup finely [[Cookbook:Chop|chopped]] [[Cookbook:Cabbage|cabbage]]
* 1 cup chopped [[Cookbook:Sweet Potato|sweet potato]]
* 1 cup peeled and chopped [[Cookbook:Carrot|carrot]]
* 1 cup peeled and chopped [[Cookbook:Turnip|turnip]]
* 1 cup chopped [[Cookbook:Okra|okra]]
* 1 cup chopped cooked [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]], or to taste

== Equipment ==

* Soup pot
* Spoon
* Stovetop

== Procedure ==

# Heat the olive oil in the pot over medium heat. Add the onion, and [[Cookbook:Sautéing|sauté]] for about 5 minutes until translucent.
# Stir ½ cup of the vegetable stock and the peanut butter into the onions until the mixture looks smooth.
# Stir in the remaining vegetable stock, diced tomatoes with their liquid, and crushed red pepper flakes; [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] for 30 minutes, stirring frequently.
# Stir in the cabbage, sweet potato, carrot, and turnip. Simmer, stirring, until the vegetables become soft (about 30 minutes). 
# Stir in the okra and chicken, and simmer for about 30 additional minutes.
